description: Scan git-staged files for security vulnerabilities before committing. Run this before every commit to catch issues early. No input needed — automatically reads staged files. Diff-aware by default: reports only issues on newly-staged lines (set diff_aware:false for whole staged files).

diff_aware.description: Report only findings on newly-staged lines (true, default) vs. all lines in staged files (false)

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

name: scan_staged
